name: Financing Date Details 1
definition: Includes a set of dates (e.g. credit date) related to settlement of the financing amount.

BookDate.name: Book Date
BookDate.definition: Date on which the financing transaction has been booked in an account.

CreditDate.name: Credit Date
CreditDate.definition: Date on which a financed amount has been credited.

DebitDate.name: Debit Date
DebitDate.definition: Date on which a financed amount has been debited.
